Paragraph action — textarea

The first line has multiple issues → a tiny Bean icon appears at the line's left. Before a user edit, Fix Obvious Issues runs locally and sends no text. After editing that paragraph, AI Proofread Paragraph may send only that changed paragraph through the Bean app. If AI is unavailable, Bean says so and applies only obvious local fixes. The single-issue last line gets no icon.

Fix Paragraph — line breaks preserved (fix first paragraph only)

Fix the first paragraph; the blank line and the second paragraph must stay exactly as-is.

Paragraph control — contenteditable blocks (icon per multi-issue block)

Each block with ≥2 issues gets its own paragraph icon; blocks group by DOM boundary (div/p), never across blocks.
